fact: The CIVICUS Monitor reports journalist Sandra Muhoza, convicted in December 2024 to 21 months for comments in a journalists' WhatsApp group, remained in prison in October 2025 although the Bujumbura Mairie Court of Appeal ruled on 30 May 2025 that the trial court lacked jurisdiction.
RSF says journalist Sandra Muhoza has been arbitrarily detained since April 2024 for relaying information about an alleged arms distribution in a private WhatsApp group.
SOS Medias Burundi reports the National Communication Council announced on 27 March 2025 the temporary suspension of the Yaga Burundi online media coalition, citing it was not registered.
